info.title: TraceQ
info.summary: Run folders read-only; Proposals in the database, behind a token.

get.description: The traceability matrix: Coverage class and reason, and cited Evidence.
The Pre-review: Check Findings, AI Findings kept apart, and missing documents.
The claims the citation check dropped, each with its subject and reason.
The URS completeness check; not found for a run written before it existed.
A document the run read, as released: a citation links here with ``#page=N``.

post.description:
Imports a run folder as Proposals, in one transaction. Importing a run already
imported changes nothing. Needs the deciding role.

get.description:
The Proposals of an imported run, in the order of its files, with their decision
state and decisions.

The Protocol Draft a Review Package run read: its Test Steps in draft order, its
traceability rows and its findings, each with its decision state once the run is
imported. Any role may read it; deciding goes through ``recordDecision``.

post.description:
Records one Proposal Decision on the content this run proposed, with its Audit
Trail entry. Earlier decisions stay. Accepting a drafted Test Step is refused (409)
while the open Protocol of its Equipment holds a written Test Step for its
requirement; ``edited`` on a drafted Test Step goes through ``editDraftedTestStep``.
Needs the deciding role.

get.description: Per kind of Proposal of an imported run: how many there are and where they stand.

post.description:
Starts the Protocol of the run's Equipment from this imported run, in Draft status,
with its Audit Trail entry. With ``from_draft`` it starts from the Protocol Draft the
run read: pinned to the run and the draft's document, revision and hash, and never
re-synced (a later revision is a new run: Return or Withdraw this one and start another
from it). Refused (409) while a Protocol of the Equipment is open (Draft or Submitted),
once one is approved, for a run whose folder has ``drafts.json`` but which holds no
drafted Test Step Proposals, and with ``from_draft`` for a run that read no draft. Needs
the deciding role.

get.description:
The Protocol most recently started from this run: its status and every status
change, and in Draft status its rows computed from the current decisions. Any
signed-in role may read it.

post.description:
Adds a version of the requirement's written Test Step in a Protocol in Draft
status: its full content (the Acceptance Criterion a range, number, one of or
present; never free text), or a removal (``test_step`` ``null``). No Reason for
Change; every version is kept, with its Audit Trail entry. Refused (409) unless the
Protocol is in Draft status, while a drafted Test Step of the requirement is
accepted, and for a removal with nothing to remove. Needs the deciding role.

Edits a drafted Test Step of the Protocol's run, in one transaction: the
``edited`` decision with its Reason for Change, and a version of the written Test
Step with the draft it came from, each with its Audit Trail entry. This is the only
way to record ``edited`` on a drafted Test Step. Refused (409) unless the Protocol is
in Draft status, and while the requirement holds a written Test Step or another of
its drafts is accepted. Needs the deciding role.

Records the disposition of a printed requirement number the Protocol's run missed,
in a Protocol in Draft status: ``not_a_requirement`` or ``not_tested_here``, with a
non-blank justification (422 without one), and its Audit Trail entry. A later one
replaces it; every one is kept. 404 for a number the run's completeness check did not
miss, or one in a URS checked ``not_applicable``; 409 unless the Protocol is in Draft
status. Needs the deciding role.

Submits a Protocol in Draft status that no check blocks; the submitter becomes its
Preparer. Stores the frozen copy and its hash in the ``submitted`` event, with its
Audit Trail entry; from then on the Protocol shows that copy, and written Test Steps
and missed-number dispositions are refused. Refused (409) unless in Draft status, and
while any check of ``checklist`` blocks (the reason lists them with their counts), and
when ``expected_draft_hash`` is not the ``draft_hash`` of the draft now (another
decider changed it after the Preparer read it); 422 without one. A Protocol started
from the Protocol Draft is frozen as a version 2 copy and needs
``expected_latest_draft_rev`` (422 without it; 409 when the Protocol is pinned to an
older revision than the latest, or the caller read another than the latest).
Needs the deciding role.

Withdraws a Protocol in Draft status, with a reason and its Audit Trail entry, so
a new Protocol of the Equipment can be started. Needs the deciding role.

Approves a Submitted Protocol: a recorded status, not an Electronic Signature (ADR 0007 phase 2). Bound to the
submission the Approver read: ``submission_event_id`` and ``hash`` must be the current
submission's, else 409 (a resubmission after a return has the same hash but a new event id).
Refused (409) for the Preparer and for anyone the frozen copy records as an author: of a
decision in force (Coverage, and every current decision on a drafted Test Step, rejections
included), or of any version of a written Test Step or of a disposition of a missed number;
the check reads the copy only; for a Protocol started from the Protocol Draft that includes
everyone who decided a finding, mapped a draft step or wrote a reason. A Protocol started from
the draft also needs ``expected_latest_draft_rev`` (422 without it; 409 when the Protocol is
pinned to an older revision than the latest, or the caller read another than the latest),
and the latest revision is recorded in the approval event. Refused (409) unless
Submitted. Once approved, no new Protocol of the Equipment can be started (a new version is
step 6). With its Audit Trail entry. Needs the approving role.

Returns a Submitted Protocol to Draft with a reason (422 without one) and its Audit
Trail entry. It reads the current decisions again; the returned copy stays readable in
``submissions``. Refused (409) unless Submitted. Needs the approving role.

put.description:
Sets ``stage`` (``IQ``, ``OQ``, or ``null``) and ``witness_required`` on a Test Step
row of a Protocol in Draft status, appending a new version and an Audit Trail entry.
Refused (409) unless the Protocol is in Draft status and the row is a ``test_step`` row.
Needs the deciding role.

Maps a Test Step of the pinned Protocol Draft to exactly one requirement of the
run, when the draft's traceability table maps it to none or to several or the citation
check dropped it; until then it is listed and unusable. Every mapping is kept with its
author (the Approver may be none of them), and the latest counts; it does not carry
over to another Protocol. Refused (409) unless the Protocol is in Draft status and was
started from the draft, for a step the table maps to exactly one requirement, and
while the step is edited into a written Test Step of this Protocol; 404 for an unknown
step or requirement. Needs the deciding role.

post.description:
Records why the row of a finding accepted on its content is submitted as it is: a
non-blank written reason (422 without one), every version kept with its author, the
latest counting. Needed to submit a row whose Test Step is not written in this
Protocol. Refused (409) unless the Protocol is in Draft status and was started from the
draft, and for a finding not accepted; 404 for a finding the run does not hold. Needs
the deciding role.

Starts the Execution of an Approved Protocol in ``in_progress`` status, with its Audit
Trail entry. Refused (409) unless the Protocol is Approved, and for a second Execution
of the same Protocol. Needs the executing role.

get.description:
Reads the Execution of the run's Protocol: its status, events and rows from the
Approved Protocol's frozen copy. Any signed-in role may read it.

post.description:
Records the first attempt on a Test Step row of an ``in_progress`` Execution, judged
by code, with instruments and automatic Deviations in the same transaction.

Adds a new version to an existing attempt with a required Reason for Change,
enforcing Performer ownership and Deviation status lock.

Records a new attempt (Retest) on a failed Test Step row, naming an Open Deviation
linked to that Test Step.

Opens a manual Deviation on an ``in_progress`` Execution, linked to one Test Step row
or to the Execution.
Records an immutable Investigation version on an ``open`` Deviation.
Submits an ``open`` Deviation once an Investigation with a class is recorded.
Closes a ``submitted`` Deviation with Anti-TOCTOU and 4-way Separation of Duties.
Returns a ``submitted`` Deviation to ``open`` with a required reason.
Records a Witness confirmation bound to the latest version's ``version_hash``.

Completes an ``in_progress`` Execution once every Test Step row has a Result and every
Deviation is Closed, freezing its copy and SHA-256 hash.

get.description:
Reads the Qualification Report state of a run's completed Execution. 404 if no
Execution exists or it is not completed. Open to any signed-in role.

post.description:
Approves and exports a Qualification Report PDF for a completed Execution. Needs the
approving role and enforces Separation of Duties against Performers, Completer,
Investigation authors, manual Deviation openers, Deviation submitters, and Witnesses.

get.description: Re-renders and downloads a stored Qualification Report PDF (zero DB writes).
Review rounds for the run's Equipment, and diff vs the previous round.

post.description: Closes an open review round. Needs the deciding role.
Generates and stores an immutable Pre-Review Report PDF export.

get.description: Re-renders and returns the stored Pre-Review Report PDF without DB writes.

Lists every Equipment known from disk runs or database records, with latest round,
protocol, execution, and qualification report summaries.
The Equipment's uploaded drafts and the limits an upload must keep.

post.description:
Queues a Protocol Draft PDF as the Equipment's next revision. The body is the PDF.
Refused when it is not a PDF (415, 422), passes the size or page cap (413, 422), holds
bytes already uploaded for the Equipment (409), or has no recording as the revision it
would be and the live budget does not cover reading it live (402).

get.description:
Where an upload stands: ``queued``, ``running``, ``succeeded`` (with its run) or
``failed`` (with why).

AiFinding.title: AiFinding
AiFinding.description: A Pre-review finding of the LLM, every citation verified; advisory (ADR 0002).

AmbiguousValue.title: AmbiguousValue
AmbiguousValue.description: An observation that reads two ways: ask for confirmation, never guess.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: What the Approver read: approval is bound to that submission and its hash.

ApproveQualificationReportRequest.title: ApproveQualificationReportRequest
ApproveQualificationReportRequest.description: Payload to approve a Qualification Report for a completed Execution.

AttemptVersionView.title: AttemptVersionView
AttemptVersionView.description: One immutable version of an attempt's Result.

AttemptView.title: AttemptView
AttemptView.description: One attempt on a Test Step row, with its versions oldest first.

Author.title: Author
Author.description: Who: the token's subject and issuer, and the name shown at the time.

CheckFinding.title: CheckFinding
CheckFinding.description: A Pre-review finding of a deterministic rule: no model involved.

ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem
ChecklistItem.description: One submission check: how many rows or missed numbers it holds back, and which.

Cite.title: Cite
Cite.description: Where a claim comes from: document, revision, page and the verbatim quote.

CloseDeviationRequest.title: CloseDeviationRequest
CloseDeviationRequest.description: Payload to close a Submitted Deviation with Anti-TOCTOU version/hash checks.

Completeness.title: Completeness
Completeness.description:
The URS completeness check of a run: printed numbers that did not become a
requirement, and URS text no kept requirement quotes.

CompletionBlockers.title: CompletionBlockers
CompletionBlockers.description: Blocking checklist computed for every Execution view.

ConfirmWitnessRequest.title: ConfirmWitnessRequest
ConfirmWitnessRequest.description: Payload to confirm an attempt's latest version as a Witness.

CorrectAttemptRequest.title: CorrectAttemptRequest
CorrectAttemptRequest.description: Payload to add a new version to an existing attempt, with a required Reason for Change.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: A recorded Proposal Decision: what, who, when and why.

DecisionCounts.title: DecisionCounts
DecisionCounts.description:
Stored decisions counted per kind of Proposal for one run. Counts, not a measure of
quality.

DesignRow.title: DesignRow
DesignRow.description: A datasheet or certificate value compared with the URS value.

DeviationEventView.title: DeviationEventView
DeviationEventView.description: One status event on a Deviation.

DeviationInvestigationView.title: DeviationInvestigationView
DeviationInvestigationView.description: One immutable version of a Deviation's Investigation.

DraftAcceptance.title: DraftAcceptance
DraftAcceptance.description:
A Test Step's Acceptance Criterion as printed, the value code read from it (none: a
form the parser does not know) and the verified citation it was read from.

DraftCheckFinding.title: DraftCheckFinding
DraftCheckFinding.description:
A Check Finding (layer Rule) on the draft, with the values it compared, as parsed. It
is on a Test Step (``test_step``) or, for ``requirement_not_tested``, on a traceability
row (``row``, the row's requirement id).

DraftComparator.title: DraftComparator
DraftComparator.description:
The vendor facts of one document a requirement's matrix row holds: shown only, never
a finding.

DraftCriterionProposal.title: DraftCriterionProposal
DraftCriterionProposal.description:
What a Proposal of kind ``draft_criterion`` holds: the Acceptance Criterion of a draft
Test Step as printed, the value code read from it and its verified citation.

DraftDocument.title: DraftDocument
DraftDocument.description: The Protocol Draft under review: document, revision and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

DraftEdit.title: DraftEdit
DraftEdit.description: An edit of a drafted Test Step: the ``edited`` decision and the Test Step it gives.

DraftFindingView.title: DraftFindingView
DraftFindingView.description: A finding on the Protocol Draft and the Proposal it was imported as.

DraftMapping.title: DraftMapping
DraftMapping.description: The requirement a draft Test Step is mapped to.

DraftMappingView.title: DraftMappingView
DraftMappingView.description: A requirement a human mapped a draft Test Step to, who and when.

DraftStepProposal.title: DraftStepProposal
DraftStepProposal.description:
What a Proposal of kind ``draft_step`` holds (spec #375, S4a1): a Test Step of the
Protocol Draft as read, with the requirements its traceability rows map it to. A human
accepts or edits it; the Acceptance Criterion is the Proposal ``draft_criterion``.

DraftStepView.title: DraftStepView
DraftStepView.description:
A Test Step of the Protocol's pinned Protocol Draft: the ones that stand for no
requirement are listed and unusable until a human maps one or rejects the step.

DraftTestStep.title: DraftTestStep
DraftTestStep.description:
A Test Step of the draft, in draft order, as read and compared, or not read: the draft
prints it, but the citation check dropped its reading (``not_read``).

DraftTraceRow.title: DraftTraceRow
DraftTraceRow.description: A row of the draft's traceability table: a requirement and its Test Step ids.

DraftTraced.title: DraftTraced
DraftTraced.description: A Test Step's AC compared with one requirement the traceability table traces it to.

DraftedTestStep.title: DraftedTestStep
DraftedTestStep.description:
An IQ/OQ Test Step the run drafted for a requirement, an AI Finding a human decides
(written by ``traceq.runs.drafts``). Not a Test Step of a site Protocol Draft
(``DraftTestStep``). The AC is present only when copied from a verified citation;
otherwise ``acceptance_flag`` says why it is "to be set by a human".

DroppedClaim.title: DroppedClaim
DroppedClaim.description: A claim the citation check dropped, with its reason in plain text.

ElectronicSignatureView.title: ElectronicSignatureView
ElectronicSignatureView.description: Public API view of an Electronic Signature binding.

EquipmentSummary.title: EquipmentSummary
EquipmentSummary.description: One Equipment's merged disk + DB lifecycle summary.

EvidenceStep.title: EvidenceStep
EvidenceStep.description: A vendor FAT/SAT step linked to a requirement, with its verdict.

ExclusiveRange.title: ExclusiveRange
ExclusiveRange.description:
A required range with at least one strict bound (``< 0,8 µm``): the bound itself fails.

A member of the Acceptance Criterion shapes of its own, not a flag on ``Range``, so that
a stored ``range`` keeps its meaning (spec #375, S4a3).

ExecutionCopy.title: ExecutionCopy
ExecutionCopy.description: The canonical frozen copy of a completed Execution (ADR 0013, spec #275).

ExecutionEvent.title: ExecutionEvent
ExecutionEvent.description: A status change of an Execution: what, who and when.

ExecutionRowView.title: ExecutionRowView
ExecutionRowView.description: One row of the Execution, in the order of the Approved Protocol's frozen copy.

ExecutionTestStep.title: ExecutionTestStep
ExecutionTestStep.description: The Test Step of a Test Step row, from the Approved Protocol's frozen copy.

ExecutionView.title: ExecutionView
ExecutionView.description: An Execution of an Approved Protocol: its status, events, and rows from the frozen copy.

FindingChangeView.title: FindingChangeView
FindingChangeView.description: One finding of either round and what became of it between them.

FindingReason.title: FindingReason
FindingReason.description: Why a row on which a finding was accepted is submitted as it is.

FindingReasonView.title: FindingReasonView
FindingReasonView.description: A Preparer's written reason on an accepted finding, who and when.

Findings.title: Findings
Findings.description:
The Pre-review of a run: Check Findings and AI Findings kept apart, and the
documents the VMP requires that the corpus lacks.

FrozenAttempt.title: FrozenAttempt
FrozenAttempt.description: One attempt on a Test Step row, with its versions oldest first.

FrozenAttemptVersion.title: FrozenAttemptVersion
FrozenAttemptVersion.description: One immutable version of an attempt's Result.

FrozenCandidate.title: FrozenCandidate
FrozenCandidate.description: A draft Test Step that stands for the row's requirement, and who decided it.

FrozenCoverage.title: FrozenCoverage
FrozenCoverage.description: The Coverage class a human decided, and the decision in force that settled it.

FrozenDecision.title: FrozenDecision
FrozenDecision.description: A Proposal Decision in force when the Protocol was submitted, and who made it.

FrozenDeviation.title: FrozenDeviation
FrozenDeviation.description: One Deviation of the completed Execution, in deviation_number order.

FrozenDeviationEvent.title: FrozenDeviationEvent
FrozenDeviationEvent.description: One status event on a Deviation.

FrozenDeviationInvestigation.title: FrozenDeviationInvestigation
FrozenDeviationInvestigation.description: One immutable version of a Deviation's Investigation.

FrozenDisposition.title: FrozenDisposition
FrozenDisposition.description: A disposition of a missed number, and who recorded it.

FrozenDraft.title: FrozenDraft
FrozenDraft.description:
A drafted Test Step of the row and the decision in force on it; ``null`` for an
undecided draft of a Vendor Reference, which needs none.

FrozenDraftStep.title: FrozenDraftStep
FrozenDraftStep.description:
A Test Step of the pinned Protocol Draft: mapped by a human, dropped by the citation
check or traced by the table, with every decision on it and on its criterion.

FrozenExecutionRow.title: FrozenExecutionRow
FrozenExecutionRow.description: One row of the completed Execution, in Protocol order.

FrozenExecutionTestStep.title: FrozenExecutionTestStep
FrozenExecutionTestStep.description: The Test Step of a Test Step row from the Approved Protocol's frozen copy.

FrozenFinding.title: FrozenFinding
FrozenFinding.description:
A finding of the Protocol Draft in the run: every decision on it with its author and
reason (rejections too), and the reasons written for submitting its row. Findings tied to
no row of the Protocol are here too.

FrozenRowDetail.title: FrozenRowDetail
FrozenRowDetail.description: What a version 2 copy records about one row beyond a version 1 row.

FrozenSource.title: FrozenSource
FrozenSource.description: The Protocol Draft the Protocol was pinned to, and the run that read it.

FrozenStepAttribute.title: FrozenStepAttribute
FrozenStepAttribute.description: One version of a Test Step row's attributes (stage and witness_required).

FrozenTestStep.title: FrozenTestStep
FrozenTestStep.description: The row's one Test Step and where it came from.

FrozenVersion.title: FrozenVersion
FrozenVersion.description: A version of the row's written Test Step: a removal, or its full content.

FrozenWitnessConfirmation.title: FrozenWitnessConfirmation
FrozenWitnessConfirmation.description: One Witness confirmation bound to an attempt version's hash.

GoverningDocument.title: GoverningDocument
GoverningDocument.description: A VMP or SOP the run read its required documents and site rules from.

InstrumentInput.title: InstrumentInput
InstrumentInput.description: One calibrated instrument used during a Test Step.

InvestigationRequest.title: InvestigationRequest
InvestigationRequest.description: Payload to record an immutable version of a Deviation's Investigation.

KindCounts.title: KindCounts
KindCounts.description:
The Proposals of one kind in a run, by decision state. ``total`` is the sum of
``undecided``, ``changed`` and the current decisions ``accepted``, ``edited`` and
``rejected``.

Limit.title: Limit
Limit.description: A limit as printed: either bound may be strict (``< 0,8 µm``).

Matrix.title: Matrix
Matrix.description: The traceability matrix of a run.

MatrixRow.title: MatrixRow
MatrixRow.description: One requirement: its text and value, Coverage class and reason, and Evidence.

MissedDisposition.title: MissedDisposition
MissedDisposition.description:
A disposition of a printed requirement number the run missed. No Reason for Change: a
later one replaces it, and every one is kept.

MissedDispositionView.title: MissedDispositionView
MissedDispositionView.description: What a human decided a missed number is: its kind and justification, who and when.

MissedNumber.title: MissedNumber
MissedNumber.description: A printed requirement number that did not become a kept requirement.

MissedNumberView.title: MissedNumberView
MissedNumberView.description: A printed requirement number that did not become a requirement of the run.

MissingDocument.title: MissingDocument
MissingDocument.description: A document the VMP requires that the corpus lacks.

NewDecision.title: NewDecision
NewDecision.description:
A Proposal Decision on the content the run proposed.

A Check Finding, AI Finding or drafted Test Step is ``accepted`` or ``rejected``; a
Coverage row is ``accepted`` or ``edited`` to another class (only ``edited`` when the
system proposed no class). A Reason for Change is required for ``rejected`` and
``edited``, and for any decision that replaces an earlier one on the same content.

NewWrittenVersion.title: NewWrittenVersion
NewWrittenVersion.description: A version of a requirement's written Test Step. No Reason for Change.

NotRead.title: NotRead
NotRead.description: A vendor document the run could not read.

NumberResultValue.title: NumberResultValue
NumberResultValue.description: Numeric measurement for a ``number`` or ``range`` Acceptance Criterion (no unit).

OneOfResultValue.title: OneOfResultValue
OneOfResultValue.description: Choice for a ``one_of`` Acceptance Criterion, or ``not_one_of`` with observed text.

OpenDeviationBlockerItem.title: OpenDeviationBlockerItem
OpenDeviationBlockerItem.description: One Deviation that is not yet Closed (``open`` or ``submitted``).

OpenDeviationsBlocker.title: OpenDeviationsBlocker
OpenDeviationsBlocker.description: Deviations that are not yet Closed.

OpenManualDeviationRequest.title: OpenManualDeviationRequest
OpenManualDeviationRequest.description: Payload to open a manual Deviation linked to a Test Step row or to the Execution.

Present.title: Present
Present.description: A feature that must exist; ``value`` is set when an observation states it.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A Proposal of a run, where it stands in the run's files, and its decision state.

ProtocolCopy.title: ProtocolCopy
ProtocolCopy.description: The frozen copy of a submitted Protocol: what the Approver reads.

ProtocolCopyV2.title: ProtocolCopyV2
ProtocolCopyV2.description:
The frozen copy of a Protocol started from the Protocol Draft: the version 1 content
(``rows``, ``urs``, the Preparer) and what the draft adds.

ProtocolDraftView.title: ProtocolDraftView
ProtocolDraftView.description:
The Protocol Draft of a Review Package run: its Test Steps in draft order, its
traceability rows and its findings, each with its decision state.

ProtocolEvent.title: ProtocolEvent
ProtocolEvent.description: A status change of a Protocol: what, who, when and why.

ProtocolRowView.title: ProtocolRowView
ProtocolRowView.description: One requirement of the run and what the Protocol holds for it.

ProtocolSource.title: ProtocolSource
ProtocolSource.description:
The Protocol Draft a Protocol was started from: pinned at creation, with the run, and
never re-synced in Draft, Submitted or Returned. A later revision never clears a warning
on it; Return or Withdraw it and start a new one from the latest revision.

ProtocolUrs.title: ProtocolUrs
ProtocolUrs.description: One URS of the run's completeness check: its missed numbers and its unquoted text.

ProtocolView.title: ProtocolView
ProtocolView.description:
A Protocol assembled in TraceQ, for one Equipment, started from one imported run. Not
a Protocol Draft: that is the site's document under Pre-review.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where a decision of a version 2 copy comes from.

QualificationReportView.title: QualificationReportView
QualificationReportView.description: Qualification Report state for a completed Execution.

Range.title: Range
Range.description: A required or tested range; either bound may be open.

RecordAttemptRequest.title: RecordAttemptRequest
RecordAttemptRequest.description: Payload to record the first attempt on a Test Step row.

RequiredDocument.title: RequiredDocument
RequiredDocument.description: A document the VMP requires for the Equipment, with the annex row cited.

RetestRowRequest.title: RetestRowRequest
RetestRowRequest.description: Payload to record a Retest (new attempt) on a failed Test Step row.

ReturnDeviationRequest.title: ReturnDeviationRequest
ReturnDeviationRequest.description: Payload to return a Submitted Deviation to Open with a required reason.

RowCandidate.title: RowCandidate
RowCandidate.description:
A Test Step of the site's Protocol Draft that stands for the row's requirement, with its
Acceptance Criterion and where each stands. Decided with ``recordDecision`` (accepted or
rejected) or edited with ``editDraftedTestStep``; an edit made in another Protocol does not
decide it here.

RowDraft.title: RowDraft
RowDraft.description:
A drafted Test Step of the row's requirement, as the run drafted it, and the Proposal it
was imported as, decided with ``recordDecision`` (accepted or rejected).

RowFindingView.title: RowFindingView
RowFindingView.description:
A finding of the Protocol Draft about the row's requirement, its decision state and the
reasons written for it in this Protocol.

RowPrefill.title: RowPrefill
RowPrefill.description: What the row's write form starts from.

RowTestStep.title: RowTestStep
RowTestStep.description: The one Test Step of a Test Step row.

RowsWithoutResultBlocker.title: RowsWithoutResultBlocker
RowsWithoutResultBlocker.description: Test Step rows that still have no recorded Result (attempts empty).

RunPackage.title: RunPackage
RunPackage.description: The Review Package a run reviews and the Protocol Draft it read.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: What identifies a run: its id, Equipment, model and mode.

SiteRuleCite.title: SiteRuleCite
SiteRuleCite.description: A site rule read from the SOP, with the sentence that sets it.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A document and revision an AI Finding cites.

StepAttributesUpdate.title: StepAttributesUpdate
StepAttributesUpdate.description: Step attributes for a Test Step row in a Draft Protocol.

SubmissionView.title: SubmissionView
SubmissionView.description: A submission of the Protocol: the frozen copy it stored and that copy's hash.

SubmitRequest.title: SubmitRequest
SubmitRequest.description: What the Preparer read: submission is bound to that draft and its hash.

Tolerance.title: Tolerance
Tolerance.description: A nominal value with a tolerance: ``380 V ± 10 %``.

ToleranceBand.title: ToleranceBand
ToleranceBand.description:
A nominal value with a symmetric tolerance (``380 V ± 10 %``), the ends included.

``tolerance_unit`` is ``%`` (of the nominal value) or the nominal's own unit.

UnconfirmedWitnessBlocker.title: UnconfirmedWitnessBlocker
UnconfirmedWitnessBlocker.description: Test Step rows requiring Witness whose latest attempt lacks an active Witness.

UnquotedText.title: UnquotedText
UnquotedText.description: URS text that no kept requirement quotes: adjacent lines merged.

UrsCompleteness.title: UrsCompleteness
UrsCompleteness.description: The completeness check of one URS the run read, built without an LLM.

VendorDocument.title: VendorDocument
VendorDocument.description: A vendor document of the Equipment the comparators of a requirement may come from.

VendorFactCite.title: VendorFactCite
VendorFactCite.description: A vendor step's observation or a design value, as printed, with its citation.

WitnessConfirmationView.title: WitnessConfirmationView
WitnessConfirmationView.description: One Witness confirmation bound to an attempt version's hash.

WrittenContent.title: WrittenContent
WrittenContent.description: The content of a Test Step a human writes or edits.

WrittenVersionView.title: WrittenVersionView
WrittenVersionView.description: A version of a written Test Step: its full content, or a removal, who and when.
